value.rationale: The same natural motif pair under the fixed-edge null can have opposite isolate covariances, and these signs remain invariant across all admissible edge totals despite changing marginal laws. The n=11 structural crossover for a five-vertex mixed motif supplies a sharp natural boundary. The G(n,p) contrast demonstrates why conditioning on total edges fundamentally changes interpretation in exact graph-motif diagnostics. This is a motivated all-parameter classification, not an arbitrarily chosen finite computation or recasting of a single mean formula.
